4834b24e529f70a890316d17a75e3efd.root_cause_summary: The NVMe SSD (/dev/nvme0n1) is experiencing hardware degradation, evidenced by pending unreadable sectors and I/O command timeouts, leading to severe write latency and controller resets.
4834b24e529f70a890316d17a75e3efd.impact_assessment: Critical risk of data corruption or loss on /dev/nvme0n1p2; potential for complete node unresponsiveness due to I/O stalls; high likelihood of cascading service failures if this node hosts stateful data.
4834b24e529f70a890316d17a75e3efd.recommended_action: Immediately drain node traffic, snapshot or evacuate data from /dev/nvme0n1p2 to a healthy volume, and initiate hardware replacement for the NVMe drive.
